label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

reclassified.why: Checked by hand: the last page record shows the checkout with a Payment heading and the payment method buttons Card, PayPal and others (or the embedded payment form); the oracle counted only radio buttons as method choices.

findings.problem: [name] banner Deny button needed two Enter presses before it closed; the first press seemed to do nothing and the banner stayed announced.
Product links on the page changed their names after images loaded, so the first jump by name failed; links also repeat the product name and start with the word Wishlist.
Pressing the product link gave no sign of loading, then an unexpected Create an account dialog opened on the product page and took focus; I had to find and close it before shopping.

Add to Bag gave no spoken confirmation at first; the Added to your shopping bag dialog only showed up on a later read. [name] buttons are named only by colour with no selected state, and the page does not say which colour is chosen.
The Checkout as guest button has the wrong accessible name Move to wishlist, which is misleading and could make a customer skip it or add the item to a wishlist instead.

A second cookie dialog opened on the partner page with Reject All available. The delivery country is locked to [name] and disabled with no explanation; the phone country code select has every option named the same as the current value, so options cannot be told apart; the phone number was rejected as not valid with the default [name] code until I changed the code to United States.

Page moves between steps with no clear announcement and an empty page title for a while; I had to read again several times to find out the page had changed. Pay Now is disabled and the card fields sit in an unlabelled iframe.

findings.problem: [name] banner Deny button needed two Enter presses before it closed; the first press seemed to do nothing and the banner stayed announced.
Product links on the page changed their names after images loaded, so the first jump by name failed; links also repeat the product name and start with the word Wishlist.
Pressing the product link gave no sign of loading, then an unexpected Create an account dialog opened on the product page and took focus; I had to find and close it before shopping.

Add to Bag gave no spoken confirmation at first; the Added to your shopping bag dialog only showed up on a later read. [name] buttons are named only by colour with no selected state, and the page does not say which colour is chosen.
The Checkout as guest button has the wrong accessible name Move to wishlist, which is misleading and could make a customer skip it or add the item to a wishlist instead.

A second cookie dialog opened on the partner page with Reject All available. The delivery country is locked to [name] and disabled with no explanation; the phone country code select has every option named the same as the current value, so options cannot be told apart; the phone number was rejected as not valid with the default [name] code until I changed the code to United States.

Page moves between steps with no clear announcement and an empty page title for a while; I had to read again several times to find out the page had changed. Pay Now is disabled and the card fields sit in an unlabelled iframe.
